fit_with_concept: Core fit: compact menu and a beer or NA pairing for an ordinary evening.
what_it_requires: Fast, consistent service and a price guests accept repeatedly.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: Guests return unprompted for a regular meal without an event.

fit_with_concept: Possible fit if the setting and pace support talking.
what_it_requires: Seating, noise control and a pace that is not rushed.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: Pairs return as a pair and cite the setting.

fit_with_concept: Shareable plates may suit it, but throughput is the risk.
what_it_requires: Shareable portions, group ordering and bill handling the kitchen can run.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: Groups of several order shared items and a member later returns with another group.

fit_with_concept: Likely busiest period; fit depends on format and location.
what_it_requires: Capacity, staffing and a queue plan that works.

fit_with_concept: Fit unclear; menu and beer must work at lower spend.
what_it_requires: A small snack menu and a simple beer offer.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: Early-evening guests order items and stay or return.

fit_with_concept: Fit depends on brewer-led beers that are distinct.
what_it_requires: Real brewed beers, a brewer and flight formats; none exist today.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: Guests order flights and a later visit is for the beer itself.

fit_with_concept: Possible if mild dishes and a welcoming setting exist.
what_it_requires: Mild options, child-appropriate seating and permit-allowed access.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: Families return with children and order mild options.

fit_with_concept: Possible for larger gatherings, not core to early tests.
what_it_requires: Reservation handling, group capacity and a set offer.
future_behavior_that_would_prove_it: A group chooses the venue for an occasion and repeats it.
